svg.title: When the marker changes the message
svg.desc: Conceptual DNA-to-RNA comparison. A red diamond marks an intended variant and a red outlined square its neighboring marker. Both are detected in DNA. A split path below shows a faint expected RNA product and a dashed alternative product, representing distinct explanations for a reduced targeted RNA readout. No experimental values are depicted.

path.aria-label: A detectable edit is also a biological edit
